ci.title: Change integrations
ci.intro: Configure producers, permitted services and credentials.
ci.name: Name
ci.namespace_hint: The name and owner Team can be edited before the first Change. Ordering changes apply only to new Changes.
ci.grant_hint: Reference permits lookup only. A Team permission includes future Services; a Service permission stays pinned to its Team.
ci.secret_once: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
ci.empty: No integrations yet. Add one to configure a producer.
ci.load_failed: Could not load data. Reload the list and try again.
ci.group_hint: The owner Group cannot be changed. Group integrations may reference only their own Teams and Services.
ci.central_hint: Not tied to a Group. Managed by global administrators only.
ci.identity_hint: Permanent identifier of this integration. Renaming it or rotating its tokens does not change this ID.
ci.credentials_hint: Only the token prefix is shown for identification. The full secret is shown once, when issued.
ci.auto_source_hint: One source will be created automatically for this Team, using the integration name. No permissions are granted automatically.
ci.no_owner_teams: No available Teams. Create an active Team in this Group first.
ci.source_locked_hint: The name and owner Team cannot be changed because this source already has Changes. Create a new source for a different name or Team. Status and ordering for new Changes remain editable.
ci.count_hint: All configured records, including disabled ones.
